cd /home/noah/propscan && PYTHONPATH=/home/noah/propscan/src python3 -c "
from propscan.core import PropScan
scanner = PropScan()
print('Available managers:', [m.name for m in scanner.get_available_managers()])

# Test with a simple package
test_package = {
    'name': 'bash',
    'display_name': 'Bash Shell',
    'version': '5.2.037-6',
    'manager': 'pacman',
    'licenses': ['GPL-3.0-or-later']
}

print('Is bash proprietary?', scanner.detector.is_proprietary(test_package))
print('Detection reason:', scanner.detector.get_detection_reason(test_package))
"
